prompt_recommendations.title: Enforce mandatory opening question in first turn
prompt_recommendations.rationale: The system instruction explicitly required a greeting + first warm-up question, but no tutor output was produced. The prompt should hard-require a pose_question call on turn 1.
prompt_recommendations.evidence_quote: Begin the lesson. Greet the student briefly, name what they'll learn in one short sentence, then immediately pose the first warm-up question via pose_question
prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit: Add a rule: 'TURN 1 IS MANDATORY: You MUST output a short greeting, a one-sentence learning goal, and call pose_question with the full stem (and options if MCQ) visible in your reply. Never end turn 1 without a posed question.'
prompt_recommendations.expected_effect: Guarantees the lesson actually starts and the student sees a question.

prompt_recommendations.title: Add explicit 'repeat last question' behavior
prompt_recommendations.rationale: When the student said 'can you ask me the question again?' the tutor produced nothing. The prompt should specify how to handle re-ask requests by restating the last posed stem verbatim.
prompt_recommendations.evidence_quote: can you ask me the question again?
prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit: Add: 'If the student asks to hear/see the question again, repeat the most recent question stem verbatim (including options) without changing the problem or giving hints.'
prompt_recommendations.expected_effect: Prevents dead-end turns when students request a repeat.

prompt_recommendations.title: Forbid empty tutor turns
prompt_recommendations.rationale: The tutor produced no visible content across the session. A rule forbidding empty responses would surface failures earlier.
prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit: Add: 'Every tutor turn must contain visible text for the student. Never respond with an empty message or a tool call alone.'

flow_recommendations.title: Retry/fallback when tutor produces no output
flow_recommendations.rationale: The orchestration allowed a completely empty session. A retry or canned fallback ('Let me re-ask: ...') should trigger when the model returns no visible content.

flow_recommendations.title: Cache last posed question for automatic re-display
flow_recommendations.rationale: Engine should store the last pose_question payload so 're-ask' requests can be served deterministically even if the model fails.
flow_recommendations.evidence_quote: can you ask me the question again?
flow_recommendations.expected_effect: Reliable repeat behavior independent of LLM variance.

experience_recommendations.title: Provide immediate acknowledgement on repeat request
experience_recommendations.rationale: An error-prone Form-3 student asking to hear the question again needs a friendly, immediate restatement to stay engaged; silence is discouraging.
experience_recommendations.evidence_quote: can you ask me the question again?
experience_recommendations.expected_effect: Better student trust and engagement, particularly for error-prone learners.
